mission_subtitle: A probing offensive against the frontier perimeter
situation_text: The Cinder Concord has pushed three columns against the salt-flat perimeter since dawn. Regional command reads it as a probing offensive, not yet a full commitment, and expects the pressure to continue through the week.

objective_primary.text: Hold the perimeter. Do not let the line break.

enemy_assessment.behavior_tag: TESTS THE LINE, DOES NOT COMMIT

reinforcement_note: Reinforcements are two days out; the garrison holds until then.
assets_note: Command fields {parity} against the entrenched attacker. The line is short on siege support; expect the cost to fall on the wall garrison, not the clock.
